guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation layout readable typography accessible tables
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use standard HTML5 landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), single <h1> with sequential heading hierarchy, semantic tables with <th scope>, and loading='lazy' with descriptive titles on iframes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: semantic landmarks, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 headings, captioned tables with scope attributes, <pre tabindex='0'><code> blocks, and loading='lazy' + title on the CPS iframe.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive iframe embed code blocks without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (inline-size, max-inline-size) and overflow-contained wrappers so wide tables and embeds never cause document-level horizontal overflow on narrow mobile viewports.
